lines: There's a cathedral 50 meters under Tokyo, and nobody prays there.
It sits 50 meters underground, linked by 6.4 kilometers of tunnels.
Its main tank is 177 meters long and 25 meters tall, held up by 59 giant pillars.
When rivers overflow, water drops into five huge silos, runs through the tunnels, and gets pumped into the Edo River.
The pumps can move up to 200 tonnes of water every second.
Work began in 1992 and finished in 2006.
Follow for a new megaproject every day.
